actualOfficialPagesBrowsed.title: Art20 GG
actualOfficialPagesBrowsed.boundedParaphrase: Democratic authority is exercised through elections, votes and state organs and remains constrained by constitutional and legal requirements.

actualOfficialPagesBrowsed.title: Art21 GG
actualOfficialPagesBrowsed.boundedParaphrase: Parties participate in political preference formation and must have a democratic internal organisation.
